A drawer holds three red socks and three blue socks, all the same size. In darkness, how many must you take to guarantee a matching pair?
3. The first two can differ; the third must match one of them.
Three identical machines make three widgets in three minutes. At that constant rate, how long do 100 machines need to make 100 widgets?
3 minutes. Each machine makes one widget in three minutes.
At exactly 3:15, what is the smaller angle between the hands of an ordinary analogue clock?
7.5 degrees. The minute hand is at 90 degrees; the hour hand is at 97.5.
Two British coins total 30 pence. One of them is not a 10p coin. What are the coins?
20p and 10p. The 20p coin is the one that is not 10p.
Alex and Bea's ages total 50. Ten years ago Alex was twice Bea's age. How old are they now?
Alex is 30 and Bea is 20. Ten years ago they were 20 and 10.
Seven animals are chickens or rabbits, with 20 legs altogether and no missing legs. How many of each?
4 chickens and 3 rabbits: 8 plus 12 legs.
Five equally efficient cats each catch one mouse in five minutes, independently. How long does one cat need for one mouse?
5 minutes. The five cats work in parallel, not one after another.
I get wetter while making other things drier. What ordinary bathroom object am I?
A towel.
What is the smallest whole-number palindrome larger than 1991?
2002. It reads identically forwards and backwards.
Find the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 1 when divided by 2, 3, 4 or 5, and is divisible by 7.
301. It is 60 x 5 + 1 and 7 x 43.
Can three straight rods of lengths 2, 3 and 6 form the sides of a triangle without bending? Explain.
No. The two shorter sides total 5, less than the longest side.
A sheet is 0.1 mm thick. In an ideal model, folding doubles thickness each time. What is its thickness after ten folds?
102.4 mm: 0.1 x 2^10. This ignores practical folding limits.
A 40-tooth gear turns once while meshed with a 10-tooth gear. How many turns does the smaller gear make, and in which direction?
4 turns, in the opposite direction.
Convert the binary number 101101 to decimal without a calculator.
A conventional IPv4 /29 subnet reserves its network and broadcast addresses. How many usable host addresses remain?
6. There are 8 addresses in total, minus 2 reserved.
Ideal 6-ohm and 3-ohm resistors are connected in parallel. What is their combined resistance?
Four equal 2 TB drives form RAID 5. Ignoring filesystem overhead, how much nominal usable capacity is there?
6 TB. The equivalent of one drive is used for parity.
In Python 3, what is len(set([1, True, 1.0]))? Explain the surprising part.
1. These values compare equal and have equal hashes, so the set keeps one element.
What values does list(range(2, 9, 3)) produce in Python 3?
[2, 5, 8]. Start at 2, add 3, stop before 9.
A FIFO queue receives A, B, C. You remove one item, then add D. In what order are the remaining items removed?
B, C, D. FIFO means first in, first out.
A two-digit positive integer has digit sum 9. Reversing its digits increases it by 27. What is the original number?
36. Its reversal is 63; 63 - 36 = 27.
Four people each play one game against every other person. How many games are played?
6: there are 4 x 3 / 2 distinct pairs.
Knights always tell the truth; knaves always lie. A says 'A and B are both knaves'. What is each person?
A is a knave and B is a knight. If A were truthful, A would also be a liar.
Boxes labelled APPLES, ORANGES and MIXED all have wrong labels. One fruit from MIXED is an apple. Which box contains what?
MIXED holds only apples; ORANGES holds the mixture; APPLES holds only oranges.
Eight identical-looking balls contain one heavier ball. With a balance scale and known equal genuine balls, what is the fewest weighings guaranteed to find it?
2. Weigh 3 against 3; then weigh 1 against 1 within the heavier group, or the unweighed pair.
Two ropes each burn for exactly 60 minutes, unevenly along their lengths. Using ignition only, how can you time 45 minutes?
Light rope A at both ends and B at one. When A finishes at 30 minutes, light B's other end; B finishes 15 minutes later.
A farmer must ferry a wolf, a goat and a cabbage. Only one passenger fits; unattended wolf-goat or goat-cabbage pairs are forbidden. Find a route.
Take goat; return alone; take wolf; return with goat; take cabbage; return alone; take goat. Seven crossings.
Nine identical-looking coins include one lighter coin. How do you find it in two balance-scale weighings?
Weigh 3 against 3. Choose the lighter group, or the unweighed group if balanced; weigh 1 against 1 from that group.
You have full 7-minute and 11-minute hourglasses. How can you mark an interval of exactly four minutes?
Start both together. The 4-minute interval starts when the 7-minute glass empties and ends when the 11-minute glass empties.
Two doors: one safe, one dangerous. Two guards know which; one always lies, one always tells truth. What single question to either guard identifies the safe door?
Ask which door the other guard would call safe, then choose the opposite door.
Change one letter at a time from COLD to WARM, using real English words and four changes. Give one route.
COLD -> CORD -> CARD -> WARD -> WARM.
Rearrange all six letters of LISTEN to make a word meaning making no sound.
SILENT.
Put the seven English weekday names in alphabetical order. Which comes first?
Friday.
Decode KHOOR by shifting each A-Z letter three places backwards, wrapping at A.
HELLO.
The nth term is n x (n + 1), starting at n = 1. The sequence is 2, 6, 12, 20, 30. What comes next?
Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that their sum is seven?
1/6. Six of the 36 equally likely ordered outcomes sum to seven.
One box holds gold. A says 'Gold is not in B'; B says 'Gold is here'; C says 'Gold is not here'. Exactly one label is true. Where is the gold?
C. Then A is true and B and C are false; either other location gives two true labels.
On a grid, go from (0,0) to (3,2), moving only one unit right or one unit up each step. How many shortest paths exist?
10. Choose which 2 of the 5 steps go up.
With an empty 3-litre jug, an empty 5-litre jug and unlimited water, measure exactly 4 litres. Neither jug has intermediate marks.
Fill 5, pour into 3, empty 3, move the remaining 2 into 3, refill 5, top up 3 with 1. Exactly 4 remain in 5.
Remove two diagonally opposite corner squares from an 8x8 chessboard. Can dominoes cover the rest if each covers two edge-adjacent squares?
No. Those corners have the same colour; unequal colour counts remain, while every domino covers one square of each colour.
